request.deadline: 12 months after closure of the existing contract; exact dates not stated in document
deliverables: Maintenance of the protobuf specification, including protocol compatibility, versioning, and documentation.
Maintenance of official SDKs, including dependency updates, performance improvements, and bug fixing.
Community support, including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, and public communication.
Upgrade UTxO RPC compatibility with AI-driven development workflows through AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe.
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Integration Standard, Year 2, including part-time maintenance and enhancement over 12 months.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The motivation states that the core request is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time maintainer for 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
UTxO RPC is described as an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers with SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python for UTxO-based blockchain integration.
The proposal states that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.
The project is said to maintain more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under the Apache 2.0 license.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposer states that the requested amount does not, alone or in aggregate at submission, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
The proposal states that prior Intersect 2025 maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC is being delivered on schedule.

Funds are proposed to be managed through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve and Project Specific Smart Contracts with specified addresses, multisignature-style role thresholds, external oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The anchor requests 540,750 ADA through Intersect to continue UTxO RPC maintenance for 12 months, presenting the work as open-source developer infrastructure with claimed ecosystem adoption, prior delivery history, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based oversight.
